title: The Memory of a Summer
overview: Ichika had a prophetic dream involving all of the girls once again fighting an unstoppable foe. Later, Laura and Charlotte go clothes shopping in preparation for their date with Ichika…in which everyone is invited!

title: Heart Pain Killer
overview: Ichika may be good at fighting, but the new student council president sees a flaw in him, and she intends to fix it.

title: Translucent Chord of Cinderella's Heel
overview: A twisted game of Cinderfella gets deadly serious, and Ichika finds himself once again at the whim of 5 beautiful women.

title: The Mysterious Lady
overview: The mysterious woman is revealed to be Arachne, and she's after Ichika's IS. A new enemy reveals itself, and it may be too powerful for the girls to handle.

title: Lovely Style
overview: Ichika is forced to be the sole judge of a Maiden Battle, where the girls take turns trying to give him the best "service" possible.

title: The Secret Base
overview: Ichika's IS is malfunctioning, so while it's away for repairs Charlotte has agreed to protect him.

title: Sisters
overview: Ichika has to choose a partner for the next tournament. Naturally, all the girls think she'll be the one to get picked.

title: Open Your Heart
overview: The girls find out who Ichika has picked for the tag tournament, and are not too happy, leaving them to train like they've never trained before.

title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
overview: A sudden raid by 5 anti IS units sends Ichika and the girls into a tailspin. During the fight, Tatenashi falls unconscious.

title: Cooking My Way
overview: Amid speculation about how to improve their IS, Cecilia goes to each of her friends in search of the perfect bento lunch for Ichika.

title: Looking For Memories
overview: The IS class goes on a leisurely field trip with the girls vying for Ichika's attention. While leaving, the class is attacked at their various locations by Phantom Task.

title: Girls Over
overview: While Ichika battles Madoka's Black Knight IS, Tatenashi engages Squall atop a skyscraper. Meanwghile, Chifuyu and her students become trapped in a monorail containing a time bomb.
